_note: Phase 392 Part 8 problem-shape vocabulary (392-02, D-01, D-02). The ONE file that holds the closed enums a brain_ask or recommend_chain call may carry beside the generic question: problem_type, stage, role, domain_tag, constraint_categories. Enum members only, no regex pattern on the wire. Twin: Theo plan 48-01 src/mcp/content/shape-packet.ts (STAGE_IDS, ROLE_IDS, DOMAIN_TAG_IDS, CONSTRAINT_CATEGORY_IDS; PROBLEM_TYPE_IDS via vocabulary.ts); one vocabulary, two repos; tests/test-392-vocabulary-drift.cjs pins every list in this repo to this file and compares Theo's five enums when readable. D-01: stage wire ids are Theo's six Phase ids; stage_map is the one table from lib/core/model-profiles.cjs VALID_STAGES to a Phase id (Pre-Opportunity Phase1, Discovery Phase2, Validation Phase3, Design Phase4, Investment Phase5); Phase0 (Orientation) is reached only by a room with no venture_stage. D-02: domain_tag is exactly the 11 eureka_critic tags of data/eureka-critic-tags.json and nothing else in this phase; constraint_categories are the nine D-02 members; the owner trims or adds later, and any change bumps schema_version in both repos. role is the seven lowercase role_blend axes of lib/core/user-md-ops.cjs; role_map projects lib/core/persona-taxonomy.cjs ROLE_BLEND_AXES onto them. problem_type_aliases projects persona-taxonomy PROBLEM_TYPES (UDP, IDP, WDP) onto the Theo rung ids; Wicked has no alias. legacy_stage_map pins persona-taxonomy VENTURE_STAGES and the informal stage words of lib/mcp/brain-router.cjs to a Phase id or to the string retired; plan 392-12 routes the live ones through stage_map and removes the retired ones. Plan 392-08 added two builder keys: role_default (the role a room gets when USER.md is missing, unparseable or a role_blend tie with no canonical_role) and constraint_keyword_map (closed lowercase whole-word keywords per constraint category; the builder lib/core/brain-shape-packet.cjs matches STATE.md constraints and blockers entries through it and emits category ids only; a keyword sits in one category only, pinned by drift leg V12). Nothing in this file names a room, a product or a person. Hyphens only, no em dash.
